rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a teacher at a school.

example.english: When I was little, the schoolteacher at my school often taught us how to write.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣，學校老師成日教我哋點樣寫字。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hok6 haau6 lou5 si1 seng4 jat6 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 dim2 joeng2 se2 zi6
